name: Midnight Royal Assassination
description: A sovereign is murdered in their bedchamber by masked assassins, throwing the court into paranoia and purges.
creativePrompt: Who paid the assassins guild? What strange poison or poisoned dagger was discovered in the chamber?
exampleNarrative: The bell tolled twenty-four times in the dead of night: the old king lay dead, and the killers had vanished over the parapet.

name: Shadow Guild Smugglers Ring
description: An underground guild builds sea caves, false floors, and bribed customs rings to move contraband through cities.
creativePrompt: What dangerous contraband is smuggled through the tunnels: untaxed silk, banned magic, or stolen silver?
exampleNarrative: Beneath the warehouse quays, secret trapdoors opened into a subterranean network of smugglers canals and safehouses.

name: Courtier Poisoner Cabal
description: A secretive ring of noble poisoners uses nightshade and arsenic to eliminate uncooperative rivals in court.
creativePrompt: Which grand duchess secretly heads the poisoner salon? What sign warns courtiers that their wine is suspect?
exampleNarrative: A drop of distilled basilisk bile in the chalice ended the grand chancellor career before the decree could be signed.

name: Forged Lineage & False Testament
description: Master scribes forge an ancient royal genealogy and will, granting a scheming duke legitimate claim to the crown.
creativePrompt: How was the parchment aged with tea and smoke? Which archivist was silenced to preserve the lie?
exampleNarrative: With aged ink and a counterfeit wax seal, the false testament produced an heir where none had existed before.

name: Infiltrated Foreign Spymaster Ring
description: A rival kingdom plants deep-cover informants in the admiralty, granaries, and mint to subvert state decisions.
creativePrompt: What coded cipher books are used to transmit naval secrets across the border in merchant caravans?
exampleNarrative: Every military order written by the war council was copied in cipher and delivered to the rival court by dawn.

name: Palace Guard Military Coup
description: The elite palace guard mutinies, arresting corrupt ministers and establishing a military martial junta.
creativePrompt: What grievance over arrears of pay or corrupt ministers drove the guard to break down the palace doors?
exampleNarrative: Halberds gleaming in the torchlight, the elite guard encircled the palace, proclaiming martial law until order was restored.

name: Secret Archive of Aristocratic Sins
description: A master spymaster compiles a vault of dark secrets, illegitimate births, and embezzlements to control council votes.
creativePrompt: Where is the secret archive hidden? What happens if the spymaster suddenly disappears?
exampleNarrative: In a locked iron vault beneath the cathedral, ledger books recorded the secret vices and debts of every senator in the realm.

name: Void Cult Infiltration of the Council
description: An insidious cosmic void cult infiltrates high office, replacing ministers with soulless doppelgangers.
creativePrompt: What ritual marks distinguish the cultists? How do players discover the doppelganger impostors?
exampleNarrative: Behind polite court smiles, vacant black eyes watched the deliberations, waiting for the hour to unseal the abyssal gate.
